scripts.start: cross-env APP_ENV=development EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo start
scripts.start:preview: cross-env APP_ENV=preview EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_PROFILE=preview LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo start --no-dev
scripts.start:production: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo start --no-dev
scripts.android: cross-env APP_ENV=development EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo run:android
scripts.android:preview: cross-env APP_ENV=preview EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_PROFILE=preview LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo run:android --variant release
scripts.android:production: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo run:android --variant release
scripts.android:apk: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true npx expo prebuild --clean --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true npx expo prebuild --clean --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew app:bundleRelease
scripts.ios: cross-env APP_ENV=development EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo run:ios
scripts.ios:preview: cross-env APP_ENV=preview EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_PROFILE=preview LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo run:ios --configuration Release
scripts.ios:production: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo run:ios --configuration Release
scripts.ios:xcode:development: cross-env APP_ENV=development EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true npx expo prebuild --clean --platform ios && open ios/*.xcworkspace
scripts.ios:xcode:production: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true npx expo prebuild --clean --platform ios && open ios/*.xcworkspace
scripts.web: cross-env APP_ENV=development EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo start --web
scripts.web:production: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo start --web --no-dev
scripts.prebuild: cross-env APP_ENV=development EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo prebuild
scripts.prebuild:preview: cross-env APP_ENV=preview EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_BUILD_PROFILE=preview LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo prebuild
scripts.prebuild:production: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true expo prebuild
scripts.build:apk:local: cross-env APP_ENV=preview EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=preview LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview --local
scripts.build:testflight:local: cross-env APP_ENV=production EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=production LOAD_LOCAL_ENV=true npx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile testflight --local
